description: List the surf zones/regions covered by SurfBooking (SurfBooking zones only: Portugal (27 zones), South Africa (4 zones), Spain (2 zones), Italy (2 zones)), with how many certified schools each has and whether lessons are bookable. Answers an open 'where can I learn to surf?' / 'best region for beginners?' question. This is about REGIONS and school coverage, never live sea conditions or per-level rankings.
